milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the gold block and look toward it, confirming visual identification. The gold block is at spawn-relative [4, 0, 6], embedded at the base of the stone brick structure. A max_distance of 8 blocks and facing_tolerance of 60° ensures the player has genuinely found and is looking at the gold block, not just wandering nearby. The sandbox preview confirmed the agent could clearly see the gold block from ~3-5 blocks away against the gray stone bricks.
